title: Front Display Panel
summary: Driver instruments reporting speed, operating status and relevant train-system indications.
purpose: Provide the driver with information for observing train speed, traction/braking response, doors and warning conditions.
observations: Current speed indication, in km/h for this teaching cab.
Master control handle position and active emergency indications.
Passenger-door and All Doors Closed status.
Brake cylinder and brake pipe values where the modeled brake instruments provide them.
interactions: Compare speed changes after power, coasting and braking requests.
Observe brake-pressure indications and read their labels and units.
Confirm door and emergency states from relevant indications.
safetyNotes: The configured cab is an educational representation; instruments and normal values vary by train.
Brake pressure and permitted-speed values in the simulator are illustrative unless validated against a specified train type.
